author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a stacked blob with a hooked top, a banded middle and four whisker lines, reading as a beetle or a bug. Three top-down redraws following the reference (bill, head, body, tail flick, four legs) still read as a beetle, trophy or turtle at 48 px. After: the same parts in profile: a flat duck bill with a rounded tip, an eye behind it, a low body whose back rises into the flat paddle tail held up at the rear (the reference's tail flick), and two short legs.
omissions: The top-down view became a side view (only two legs visible), because the top view reads as an insect at 48 px.
